screen: Test set-up
steps: Ask the developer to start the app (web on port 3000, API, database) and to load fresh demo data (the seed).
The seed prints the demo passwords at the end. Keep that list next to you (it is also the last line of apps/api/prisma/seed.ts).
Open Mailpit at http://localhost:8025 in a second tab. All emails (codes, reset links, alerts) arrive there.
Start the test sign-in server for Google / Microsoft (see README).
Install an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
Use Chrome. For "a second browser" use a Chrome Incognito window.
expected: The sign-in page opens. Mailpit opens and shows the inbox. You have the demo password list.
note: Demo company: Kaveri Foods (web address name demo-org). Sites: Bengaluru head office, Chennai office, Hosur plant. People: Ramesh (MD), Lakshmi (HR, hr@), Divya (QA manager, panel@), Arjun, Meera, Kiran (Divya's team, Bengaluru), Kavya (Hosur plant), Rahul (Sales). Admin, HR and Payroll accounts need two-step verification: do MT-1-09 for each of them first.

screen: Sign-in - first screen
steps: Open the sign-in page in a fresh Incognito window.
Look at the screen without typing anything.
expected: You see "Work email" with a Continue button, an "or" line, then "Sign in with a passkey", "Continue with mobile", "Continue with Microsoft" and "Continue with Google" (each shows only when the company allows it). There is no box for a company code.

screen: Sign-in - email and password
steps: Type hr@demo-org.test in Work email.
Click Continue.
Type the password from the demo list and click Sign in.
If asked, give your second step (authenticator code).
expected: You are signed in to Kaveri Foods and land on a YukthiX page. Your name (Lakshmi Venkatesan) shows in the menu.

screen: Sign-in - wrong password
steps: Type recruiter@demo-org.test and click Continue.
Type a wrong password, for example Wrong-pass-1, and click Sign in.
expected: A red message "Wrong email or password. Try again." shows. You stay on the password step. No hint about whether the account exists.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Sign-in - unknown email gives no hint
steps: Type nobody@demo-org.test and click Continue.
Type any password and click Sign in.
expected: The same "Wrong email or password. Try again." message as a wrong password. Nothing tells you the email does not exist or which company it is.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Sign-in - wrong password lockout
steps: First check the lockout number in Settings > Security (MT-4-04). The default is 10 wrong tries.
Type recruiter@demo-org.test, Continue, then a wrong password. Click Sign in.
Repeat the wrong password until you reach the lockout number.
Now type the correct password and click Sign in.
Open Mailpit.
expected: After the limit you see "Too many tries. Try again in N min N sec." and the time counts down on screen. Even the correct password does not work while locked. Mailpit has an email "Sign-in to your YukthiX account was temporarily locked" for the recruiter. The lock ends after the lock time (default 15 minutes) or when an admin unlocks it (MT-2-12).
note: NEGATIVE test. Use only the recruiter account. Repeated failures from one network can also block other accounts for a short time; if that happens, wait 15 minutes.

screen: Sign-in - YukthiX staff account on the company screen
steps: Type super@platform.test and click Continue.
Type the staff password from the demo list and click Sign in.
expected: Sign-in is refused with the same "Wrong email or password. Try again." message. YukthiX staff never sign in through the company sign-in screen, and staff accounts never appear in the company picker.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Sign-in - email code
steps: First, as admin, turn on Email under "Sign in with a one-time code" in Settings > Security (MT-4-05).
Sign out. Open the sign-in page.
Type panel@demo-org.test and click Continue.
Click "Email me a code instead".
Open Mailpit, open the email whose subject is "<code> is your YukthiX sign-in code" (it starts with the 6-digit code) and copy the code.
Type the code in "6-digit code" and click Sign in.
expected: The email has only the code, what it is for and when it expires (5 minutes). After typing the code you are signed in as Divya.
note: Divya is not in a sensitive role, so no second step is asked. Admin, HR and Payroll still give their second step after the code.

screen: Sign-in - email codes off, button hidden
steps: As admin, untick Email under "Sign in with a one-time code" in Settings > Security and save.
Sign out. Type panel@demo-org.test and click Continue.
Look at the password step.
expected: There is no "Email me a code instead" button. Only the password (and other allowed methods) are offered.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Two-step setup - authenticator app
steps: Sign in as admin@demo-org.test for the first time (no second step set yet).
On "Secure your account" pick the "Authenticator app" card. The QR code shows at once.
Scan the QR code with the authenticator app on your phone.
Type the 6-digit code from the phone and click "Turn on".
Copy, download or write down the recovery codes. Tick "I have saved my recovery codes" and click Continue.
expected: The page "Your account is secure - Last step: keep a way back in." shows recovery codes once. After Continue you land on the admin pages. Repeat this for hr@, payroll@ and plant-hr@ before the other tests.

screen: Two-step setup - passkey
steps: Sign in as payroll@demo-org.test (or use My security > "Add a sign-in method" if the authenticator is already set).
Pick the "Passkey" card (it carries a "Recommended" badge). The Windows Hello / phone prompt starts at once; there is no second button.
Follow the prompt (fingerprint, face or PIN).
Save the recovery codes, tick the box and click Continue.
expected: The passkey is saved. Next time, the second step offers "Passkey" first and it works with the fingerprint / PIN.

screen: Two-step setup - remind me later (grace period)
steps: Sign in with an account in a sensitive role that has no second step yet (ask the developer to reset one if all are set).
On "Secure your account" read the date in the subtitle.
Click "Remind me later".
Open an admin page.
expected: The subtitle says "Your role needs it. Set it up by <date>" (14 days). After "Remind me later" you can work, but a yellow banner "Secure your account" shows: "Your role needs a passkey or an authenticator app. Set it up by <date>; after that, admin pages pause until you add one." with a "Set it up now" link. After the date, admin pages pause until you add a second step.

screen: Sign-in - second step with authenticator
steps: Sign out. Sign in as admin@demo-org.test with the password.
On "Confirm it's you" choose "Authenticator app".
Type the current 6-digit code from your phone and continue.
expected: You are signed in. Login activity (MT-2-10) shows this sign-in as "Two-step".

screen: Sign-in - second step with a recovery code
steps: Sign out. Sign in as admin@demo-org.test with the password.
On "Confirm it's you" choose "Recovery code".
Type one of the saved recovery codes and continue.
Sign out and try the same recovery code again.
expected: The first time you are signed in. The second time the same code is refused (each code works only once).

screen: Sign-in - wrong second-step code
steps: Sign in as admin@demo-org.test with the password.
On "Confirm it's you" choose "Authenticator app" and type 000000.
expected: An error shows and you are not signed in. "Start again" takes you back to the first screen.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Sign-in - remembered company and "Not your company?"
steps: Sign in once as hr@demo-org.test, then sign out.
Open the sign-in page again in the same browser.
Look at the top of the form.
Click "Not your company?".
expected: The page says "Signing in to Kaveri Foods" with the company logo or initials, and only the sign-in methods Kaveri Foods allows. After "Not your company?" the company line disappears and the general first screen shows again.

screen: Sign-in - company screen shows only allowed methods
steps: As admin, in Settings > Security make sure "Allow sign-in with Google" is OFF and "Allow sign-in with Microsoft" is OFF. Save.
Sign out. Open the sign-in page in the same browser (company is remembered).
expected: The "Signing in to Kaveri Foods" screen does not show "Continue with Google" or "Continue with Microsoft".
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Sign-in - Continue with Google (test sign-in server)
steps: Start the test sign-in server (see README).
As admin, turn ON "Allow sign-in with Google" in Settings > Security and save.
Sign out. On the sign-in page click "Continue with Google".
On the test sign-in page choose or type hr@demo-org.test and continue.
Give your second step if asked.
expected: You come back to YukthiX signed in as Lakshmi (HR) in Kaveri Foods.

screen: Sign-in - Continue with Microsoft (test sign-in server)
steps: As admin, turn ON "Allow sign-in with Microsoft" in Settings > Security and save.
Sign out. On the sign-in page click "Continue with Microsoft".
On the test sign-in page choose or type hr@demo-org.test and continue.
expected: You come back signed in as Lakshmi in Kaveri Foods.

screen: Sign-in - Google when the company has it off
steps: As admin, turn OFF "Allow sign-in with Google" and save.
Sign out. Click "Not your company?" if shown, then click "Continue with Google" on the general first screen.
On the test sign-in page use hr@demo-org.test.
expected: You are NOT signed in to Kaveri Foods. The message "We couldn't sign you in with that account. Try another way, or ask your admin." shows. It does not say whether an account exists.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Sign-in - Continue with mobile
steps: First verify a mobile number for Divya in My security (MT-2-06) and, as admin, tick SMS under "Sign in with a one-time code" (MT-4-05).
Sign out. Click "Continue with mobile". Type Divya's mobile number and continue.
Type the 6-digit code from the text message and click Sign in.
expected: You are signed in as Divya.
note: On a local machine texts go to a development sink and are not shown; if you cannot get the code, mark Blocked.

screen: Sign-in - company picker
account: consultant@sharma-advisory.test (partner user with accounts in Kaveri Foods and Ganga Textiles)
steps: Type consultant@sharma-advisory.test and click Continue.
Type the password from the demo list and click Sign in.
On "Choose your company" pick one company.
expected: "Choose your company" lists Kaveri Foods and Ganga Textiles (name and logo only). After picking, you are signed in to that company. "Sign in another way" goes back to the start.
note: The demo data has two companies for this email. plant-hr@demo-org.test also works.

screen: Forgot password
steps: On the sign-in password step click "Forgot your password?".
Type recruiter@demo-org.test and click "Email me a reset link".
Open Mailpit and open the reset email. Click the link within 15 minutes.
Set a new password of at least 12 characters and sign in with it.
expected: The page says "If recruiter@demo-org.test has a YukthiX account, we sent it a reset link." No company is asked. The email arrives in Mailpit and the new password works.
note: Afterwards tell the developer the recruiter password changed (or reload the seed).

screen: Forgot password - unknown email
steps: Type nobody@demo-org.test and click "Email me a reset link".
Open Mailpit.
expected: The same "If ... has a YukthiX account, we sent it a reset link" message shows. No email arrives in Mailpit. Nothing reveals that the account does not exist.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: New password rules
steps: Open a reset link from Mailpit (as in MT-1-22).
Try a short password like Short1!.
Try a well-known password like Password123456.
expected: Both are refused: the short one for being under 12 characters, the well-known one because it is in a list of breached passwords.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: New-device alert email
steps: Sign in as panel@demo-org.test in a new Incognito window (a device it has not used).
Open Mailpit.
expected: Mailpit has an email "New sign-in to your YukthiX account" for Divya.

screen: My security - overview
steps: Sign in as hr@demo-org.test.
In the menu click Me > My security.
expected: You see: "Sign-in methods" (your passkeys and authenticator apps), "Recovery codes", "Password", "Mobile number", "Where you're signed in" and "Sign-in history".

screen: My security - add a passkey
steps: Under "Add a sign-in method" pick the "Passkey" card (it carries a "Recommended" badge).
Confirm it's you if asked, then follow the Windows Hello / phone prompt.
expected: The passkey appears under "Your sign-in methods" as "Passkey · <name>" with Rename and Remove buttons. Mailpit has an email about the security change.

screen: My security - add an authenticator app
steps: Under "Add a sign-in method" pick the "Authenticator app" card.
Scan the QR code with your phone app and type the 6-digit code. Click "Turn on".
expected: A second entry, "Authenticator app", appears under "Your sign-in methods".

screen: My security - cannot remove the only second step
steps: Use an account with exactly one second step (for example payroll@ with only the authenticator).
Look at the Remove button next to it.
expected: You see "You can't remove your only sign-in method, because your role needs one. Add another first." The Remove button is disabled (its tooltip says "Your role needs at least one").
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: My security - new recovery codes
steps: Under "Recovery codes · N of 10 left" click "Make new codes".
In the "Confirm it's you" dialog confirm with your passkey or authenticator.
Save the codes with "Copy codes" or "Download", then tick "I have saved my recovery codes".
Try one of the OLD codes at the next sign-in.
expected: Before the new codes show you must confirm it's you. The new codes show once, with Copy codes and Download buttons. The old codes no longer work.

screen: My security - verify a mobile number
steps: Under Mobile number type a mobile number and click "Text me a code".
Type the code in "Code from the text" and click "Verify number".
expected: The number shows "Verified. Used for sign-in codes where your company allows them."
note: Locally the text goes to a development sink and is not shown. If you cannot get the code, mark Blocked.

screen: My security - sign out one session
steps: Sign in as hr@ in Chrome AND in an Incognito window.
In Chrome open My security > "Where you're signed in".
Click "Sign out" on the other session (not "This browser").
In the Incognito window click any menu link.
expected: The other session disappears from the list. In Incognito you are sent back to the sign-in page.

screen: My security - sign out everywhere else
steps: Sign in as hr@ in two more browsers or Incognito windows.
In Chrome click "Sign out everywhere else".
expected: Only "This browser" stays in the list. The other windows go to the sign-in page on their next click.

screen: My security - sign-in history
steps: Scroll to "Sign-in history".
Change the Show filter to failed attempts, then back to all.
expected: You see only YOUR own sign-ins with result, method, device, IP and time. Failed attempts show when you filter for them.

screen: Login activity - company sign-ins
steps: Sign in as admin@. Click Security > Login activity.
On "Sign-in attempts" set Result to Failed. Then filter by Method, by Person (the list starts at "Everyone") and by a date range.
If the yellow banner about failed attempts shows (20 or more in the last 24 hours), click "Show failed attempts".
expected: You see the sign-ins of Kaveri Foods only, with the filters working. Result offers Signed in, Failed, Blocked, Wrong second step, Code sent and Unlocked by admin. The number of failed attempts in the last 24 hours shows in the header. New devices are marked "New device".

screen: Login activity - who is signed in now
steps: Open the "Signed in now" tab.
Find hr@'s session and click "Sign out". Confirm.
expected: The list shows people signed in now with how they signed in (One step / Two-step). After Sign out, hr@ must sign in again.

screen: Login activity - unlock a locked account
steps: First lock recruiter@ (MT-1-05).
In Login activity set Result to Failed. Find recruiter@'s newest Failed row: it carries the badge "Locked the account" and an Unlock button. Click "Unlock".
Type a reason of at least 10 characters and click "Unlock account". Confirm it's you if asked.
Sign in as recruiter@ with the right password.
expected: The unlock asks for a reason (at least 10 characters) and your second step. After it, the recruiter can sign in, Mailpit has an email "Your YukthiX account was unlocked" for the recruiter, and a new "Unlocked by admin" row appears in Sign-in attempts. Unlock shows only on the lock that is still active, never on an old lock.

screen: Login activity - not for normal staff
steps: Sign in as panel@demo-org.test.
Look at the menu. Then type the Login activity web address directly.
expected: There is no Login activity link. Opening the address shows "You don't have access to this page" (or no data).
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Legal entities - list
steps: Sign in as admin@. Click Organisation > Legal entities.
expected: You see Kaveri Foods Pvt Ltd (KFPL, marked Default) and Kaveri Foods Pvt Ltd (Tamil Nadu) (KFPL-TN). Each shows "India - data kept in India".

screen: Legal entities - add an entity
steps: Click "Add legal entity".
Fill Registered name (for example Kaveri Test Pvt Ltd), Short name (KTEST), Currency, Financial year starts in, Registered address.
Type a wrong PAN (for example 12345) and try to save.
Fix the PAN to a valid format (5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter) and save.
expected: A wrong PAN is refused with a clear message. With a valid PAN the entity is added. Country / data region cannot be changed later.

screen: Legal entities - make default
steps: Open the row menu of the new entity and choose "Make default". Confirm.
Then make Kaveri Foods Pvt Ltd the default again.
expected: Only one entity is Default at any time. The message says new hires and imports start with this entity.

screen: Legal entities - identifiers hidden without access
steps: As admin@ look at the Identifiers column.
expected: Admin sees only "All on file" or "None on file", never the PAN / TAN / GSTIN numbers. There is no Identifiers button.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Legal entities - open identifiers (Payroll)
steps: Sign in as payroll@. Open Organisation > Legal entities.
Click "Identifiers" on Kaveri Foods Pvt Ltd.
Confirm it's you.
expected: After the second step the PAN, TAN, GSTIN and CIN show. The look is recorded.

screen: Company rules - entity rules
steps: On Legal entities find the "Company rules" part ("Employee codes are unique", "New masters are").
Change "Employee codes are unique" and click "Save rules".
expected: The rule saves with "Saved.". If codes would clash, the switch is refused and the clashes are listed.

screen: Locations - list and add
steps: Click Organisation > Locations.
Click "Add location". Fill Legal entity, Name (Mysuru office), Code, Address, State and Time zone.
Tick "Use a geofence" and fill Latitude, Longitude and Radius. Add an allowed network like 203.0.113.0/24.
Save.
expected: You see Bengaluru head office, Chennai office and Hosur plant, and the new Mysuru office under its legal entity.

screen: Locations - state and time zone required
steps: Click "Add location". Fill only Legal entity and Name. Leave State and Time zone empty.
Try to save.
expected: Saving is refused. The empty State and Time zone fields are marked.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Locations - archive, restore, delete
steps: Open the row menu of Mysuru office and choose Archive. Confirm.
Tick "Show archived", open the menu and choose Restore.
Try Delete on Hosur plant (used by people).
expected: Each action asks to confirm. An archived location is hidden and cannot be chosen for new people. Hosur plant cannot be deleted because it is in use; only Archive is offered.

screen: Structure - departments tree
steps: Click Organisation > Structure. Open the Departments tab.
Click "Add department". Name it Packaging, Parent = Operations. Save.
Edit Operations and set its Parent to Packaging (its own child). Save.
expected: Operations shows as a Division with Quality and Production under it. Packaging is added under Operations. Moving Operations under its own child is refused (no loops).

screen: Structure - designations and codes
steps: Open the Designations tab. Click "Add designation".
Type a name, leave Code empty, choose Ownership "One entity only" and pick KFPL-TN. Save.
Add another designation with the same name.
expected: The first one gets a code made for it. The duplicate name is refused.

screen: Structure - grades and pay ranges hidden without pay access
steps: Sign in as hr@. Open Structure > Grades.
expected: Grades W1 to M4 are listed. There is NO "Show pay" button: HR without pay access never sees pay ranges.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Structure - pay ranges (Payroll)
steps: Sign in as payroll@. Open Structure > Grades.
Click "Show pay" on G2. Confirm it's you if asked.
Click "Add range": Legal entity KFPL, Currency INR, Starts = a future date, Minimum, Midpoint, Maximum. Click "Add range".
Try to add a second range for the same grade, entity and currency that overlaps it.
expected: The pay ranges drawer shows "Pay is private. Opening this list is recorded". The current range is "In force". The new range ends the old one the day before it starts; the past is not changed. An overlapping range is refused.

screen: Structure - employment types
steps: Open the Employment types tab. Click "Add employment type".
Fill Name and Category (for example Consultant). Save.
expected: It appears in the list with its category. Fixed-term (plant) shows as KFPL-TN only.

screen: Structure - cost centres
steps: Open the Cost centres tab. Click "Add cost centre".
Choose Legal entity KFPL and Parent cost centre "Hosur production" (which belongs to KFPL-TN). Save.
expected: Saving is refused: a cost centre and its parent must be in the same legal entity.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Structure - archive a used master
steps: On Designations open the menu of "Quality Analyst" (used by people) and choose Delete.
Choose Archive instead. Then open Add person (MT-6-02) and look at the designation list.
Back on Structure, tick "Show archived" and Restore it.
expected: Delete is refused for a used record. An archived designation is not offered for new people. After Restore it can be chosen again.

screen: Company rules - values and where they come from
steps: Click Organisation > Company rules.
Look at Job changes, Probation and Attendance.
On "Attendance mode" look at the rows for the company and for Bengaluru head office.
expected: Each rule shows its value and where it comes from ("Set for your company" or "YukthiX starter, not changed yet"). Attendance is "Punch in and out" for the company and "Present unless on leave" for Bengaluru head office.

screen: Company rules - change a dated rule
steps: On "Attendance mode" click Change.
Applies to = Location, Hosur plant. Value = Timesheet. Applies from = a future date. Save.
expected: The new row shows with a "Scheduled" badge. Earlier days keep the old value.

screen: Company rules - probation and retro limit
steps: Change "Probation lasts (months)" for the company to 3.
Change "Past-dated changes may go back to" to "Start of last financial year".
expected: Both save. The probation length is used for new joiners. The retro limit changes the date shown in the job-change form (MT-7-07).

screen: Security settings - page and minimums
steps: Sign in as admin@. Click Security > Security settings.
expected: You see the sections Second sign-in step, Sign in with a one-time code, Single sign-on, Sessions, Network allow-lists, Account lockout, Passwords. A note says YukthiX sets minimums. Each field shows the allowed range.

screen: Security settings - not for HR
steps: Sign in as hr@. Type the Security settings address directly.
expected: There is no Security settings link in the menu. The page says you do not have access.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Security settings - MFA for everyone
steps: Under "Who needs a second step" choose Everyone.
Click "Save changes" and confirm it's you.
Sign in as recruiter@ in Incognito.
Set it back to "Sensitive roles" and save.
expected: Saving asks for your second step. While "Everyone" is on, the recruiter is asked to set up two-step verification.

screen: Security settings - lockout rules
steps: In Account lockout set "Lock after" to a number above the allowed maximum (for example 50). Click Save changes.
Set "Lock for" below the minimum (for example 1). Save.
Set "Lock after" to 5 and "Lock for" to 15. Save.
expected: Values weaker than the YukthiX minimum are refused with a red message next to the field. 5 and 15 save with "Saved.".
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Security settings - one-time code channels
steps: In "Sign in with a one-time code" tick Email (and SMS if you have a gateway).
Save and confirm it's you.
expected: Saved. The email code button appears on the sign-in screen (MT-1-07).

screen: Security settings - text code not allowed as only factor
steps: Under the allowed second steps untick Passkey and Authenticator app, leaving only "Code by SMS or WhatsApp (backup only)".
Click Save changes.
expected: Refused: "Keep passkey or authenticator app allowed".
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Security settings - password minimum
steps: In Passwords set "Minimum password length" to 8. Save.
Set it to 14. Save.
expected: 8 is refused (minimum 12). 14 saves.
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Security settings - session limits
steps: Set "Sign out on the web after no activity for" to 600 minutes (10 hours). Save.
Set it longer than "Longest web session". Save.
expected: Both are refused with a message (idle limit max 8 hours; idle cannot be longer than the longest session).
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: Security settings - allow Google / Microsoft sign-in
steps: Find "Allow sign-in with Google" and "Allow sign-in with Microsoft".
Turn Google on. Save and confirm it's you.
expected: The switches save. The sign-in screen for Kaveri Foods now shows "Continue with Google" (MT-1-17).
note: New sign-in screen is being built now. May still be in progress.

screen: Security settings - single sign-on providers
steps: In Single sign-on click "Add identity provider" (or "Manage identity providers").
Look at the page that opens.
expected: The identity provider page opens, where Google, Microsoft Entra ID, OpenID Connect or SAML can be added. Back on Security settings each provider shows On or Off.
note: The provider page is the older admin page (/v2/settings/sso).

screen: Security settings - SSO only needs an active provider and 2 emergency admins
steps: Look at "Sign in only through your identity provider".
If a provider is on: tick it, choose only 1 emergency admin and save.
expected: With no active provider the box cannot be ticked ("Turn on an identity provider first"). With a provider, saving with fewer than 2 emergency admins is refused.
note: NEGATIVE test. The demo company has one admin, so you will see the refusal.

screen: Security settings - verify an email domain
steps: Add an identity provider with an email domain (for example kaverifoods.test) on the provider page.
Back on Security settings, under Email domains read the TXT record.
Click "Check record".
expected: The domain shows "Not verified" with the TXT record to publish. "Check record" says the record was not found (no real DNS locally). Not-verified domains never send people to the provider.

screen: Security settings - lapsed domain
steps: Ask the developer to set up a verified domain whose TXT record was then removed (the daily re-check marks it Lapsed after repeated misses).
Open Security settings and look at Email domains.
expected: The domain shows a yellow "Lapsed" badge and the text "Repeated checks have not found the TXT record ... Put the record back, then check it." Sign-ins no longer go to the identity provider.
note: Needs developer setup. Story US-A-035 is "New" in the tracker but the code is in the workspace branch. May still be in progress.

screen: Security settings - IP allow-list
steps: In Network allow-lists type 203.0.113.0/24 under "Admin pages". Save.
Open Settings > Legal entities.
Clear the list and save again (use another admin session or ask the developer if you are locked out).
expected: Admin pages are refused from your network while the list does not include it. Clearing the list allows any network again.
note: NEGATIVE test. Careful: this can lock you out of admin pages. Keep a second signed-in window open to undo it.

screen: SMS settings - page
steps: Click Security > Text messages (SMS).
expected: You see Sending (use the YukthiX shared account, Monthly limit), Your accounts (or "No accounts of your own.") and the Delivery log.

screen: SMS settings - add a gateway account
steps: Click "Add account".
Name: Test gateway. Gateway: Development. Sender: KAVERI. DLT entity id: digits only.
In One-time-code template fill DLT template id (digits) and Registered text.
Click "Add account" and confirm it's you.
Click Edit on the new account.
expected: The account is listed with its sender and template status. On Edit, secrets are empty: they are never shown again.

screen: SMS settings - field checks
steps: Click "Add account". Type letters in "DLT entity id" and leave Name empty. Try to save.
expected: Refused with "Enter a name" and "The DLT entity id is digits only".
note: NEGATIVE test.

screen: SMS settings - test send
steps: If the Send test button is off, click "Verify my number" and verify your mobile (MT-2-06).
Click "Send test" on the Test gateway account.
